"Lzahlia" or "Lzahlian" is a term used by "Hazl Lzah" [[57]] a founding Co-Author and Contributor of this project [[56]].

"Lzahlia" came to be a signature; distinguishing "Lzahlia methodologies" from "..."

Her work spans Domains from ... to ... She describes her work, however as something of a "Living, breathing, organic web of chaos which finds form; something of a micro-cosm; a Youniverse of ideas, knowledge, studies and recordings from Human life."

Her life's work ultimately points towards a unified goal: "Record as much of the Human experience as possible, as close to it's real depth and breadth; for when something is made visible and recorded, it's true conditions and issues will be made visible; and such is man's search for meaning."

Infact, the "microcosm" is one of the most important contributions by Lzahlia's studies; proposing an internal "youniverse" within every Human being. Read more at [[149]]

Lzahlia's quotes capture the Ethos [[148]] of her work: **"Debates are pointless without real, positive Human change. When we map things, we may fickle amongst ourselves, but one thing is for certain;"**
